conviction_note: Near non-result with a slight negative lean. The H2 guide was reaffirmed in a deck filed 9 days after Q3 closed, and Tesla has confirmed Semi volume production. Against that, Q3 growth will look back-loaded, a going-concern-flagged company has called a Dec-22 EGM for authority to issue shares without pre-emption, and the first public print (H1, 2026-08-18) was sold on the day. Findings sum -0.5; scaled: (2*0.46-1)*9 = -0.72. The two agree in sign and size.
bar: No sell-side consensus could be sourced: one analyst (Canaccord, Buy, $8 PT, initiated 2026-09-15; https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/options-einride-nasdaq-enrd-stock-short-interest-climbs-821-2026-11-01/), and its estimates were not found. The only sourced bar is the company's own guide, reaffirmed in the Oct 9 2026 corporate presentation (6-K exhibit, slide 15, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2095096/000149315226046565/ex99-1.htm): H2 2026 constant-currency revenue $39-42m (+60-73% on H2 2025 $24.3m), Dec-2026 run-rate $85-95m (+74-94% on $49m), H2 adjusted EBITDA -$39-41m. There is no Q3-only guide. Every finding is capped small because of this. print_vs_bar_pct=0 means I expect the H2 guide to be maintained.

next_guide.basis: Management repeated the full H2 guide on 2026-10-09, after Q3 had closed and they had the September numbers. Tesla confirmed Semi volume production in Q3 (Oct 21). The CEO said only about 75 Semis deploy in 2026. So the H2 number does not hinge on a 2027-heavy Tesla ramp, and a cut is less likely than a maintain. The Dec run-rate is the line most exposed.

findings.finding: Einride's Oct 9 2026 corporate presentation, filed as a 6-K nine days after Q3 ended, repeated the whole H2 2026 guide: revenue $39-42m constant currency (+60-73% on $24.3m), Dec-2026 run-rate $85-95m (+74-94%), H2 adjusted EBITDA -$39-41m. With no street consensus, this guide is the market's bar, and a reaffirmation made with Q3 in hand lowers the odds of a guide cut on Nov 18.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell -6.25% around the Oct 9 6-K (baseline bar data; the history is not a trustworthy earnings base rate). There is only one prior guidance event, the H1 print (2026-08-18): -6.98% on the event day, then +5.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and the stock fell after it, so a held guide is mostly priced. The residual value is that the reaffirmation post-dates the Q3 close, which a cut-fearing tape (-15% over 20 days, -86% from the high) does not seem to credit. If it were priced, the stock would not be trading 73% below the only target.
findings.independence: Tesla's Q3 update says Semi volume production started (separate finding, different source). It shares the guide numbers with the H1 release, https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6423648.

findings.finding: Tesla's Q3 2026 update (Oct 21) says Semi volume production began on its high-volume Nevada line in Q3. Tesla is the supplier of the 500 Semis Einride is deploying from September 2026 (about 75 in 2026 per the CEO), so the supplier-side risk to the Q4 ramp and the Dec run-rate has eased.
findings.link: Tesla is the sole supplier of the 500 Semis in Einride's 2026-08-18 deployment deal, which management says would triple the deployed electric fleet (about 250 to about 750 vehicles). About 75 deploy in 2026; Amazon is the named customer.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Tesla deal announcement (2026-08-18, with H1) produced a pre-market rally and a -6.98% close on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: Tesla news is not read through to a $300m Swedish ADS with $150k a day of turnover and one analyst. If it were, ENRD would have firmed after Oct 21 instead of making new lows on Nov 5.
findings.independence: Separate from finding 1. Tesla's production start does not show how many Semis Einride actually received; secondary coverage only, https://electrive.com/2026/10/22/tesla-q3-results-full-order-books-but-declining-figures.

findings.finding: The guide is Q4-heavy, so Q3 alone will likely print growth below the 60-73% H2 rate. The CEO said only about 75 Tesla Semis deploy from September to December (Aug 27 interview). The Dec run-rate of $85-95m implies about $7.1-7.9m a month in December against an H2 average of $6.5-7.0m. My arithmetic puts Q3 at roughly $17-20m constant currency, about +40-65% year on year: an acceleration from H1's 26%, but under the headline guide rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Only one prior revenue print (H1, +26% cc). The stock closed -6.98% on the day even though the growth matched the pre-announced framing.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody publishes a Q3 estimate. Readers anchor on the 60-73% headline, so a Q3 figure in the 40s or 50s may read as a slowdown against the guide even if H2 is intact.
findings.independence: The Q3 split is my inference from the guide on slide 15, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2095096/000149315226046565/ex99-1.htm, and the CEO's interview. The company does not state a Q3 figure. Shares the guide document with finding 1.

findings.finding: A Nov 13 6-K calls an EGM for Dec 22 2026 to lift the share-count ceiling to 587.6m (4x the 146.7m outstanding) and to authorise the board to issue shares, warrants and convertibles with pre-emption disapplied, 'for future capital raises'. The F-1 carries a going-concern risk factor. Cash was $77m (SEK 748m) at June 30 after SEK 537m of operating cash burn in H1, and the H2 adjusted EBITDA guide is -$39-41m. The Nov 18 update will likely disclose Sept-30 cash with well under a year of runway, which makes a deeply dilutive raise near-certain.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock moved -2.01% around the Nov 13 EGM 6-K (baseline bar data). The resale F-1 going effective on 2026-09-25 preceded a slide from about $4 to about $2.
findings.why_not_priced: The EGM itself is priced: the stock is -86% from its high and -2% on the notice. Not yet priced is the size and timing of the raise, which the call will be asked about. A Sept-30 cash figure has never been published. If the size were priced, the stock would not have bounced 20% off its Nov 5 low into the print.
findings.independence: F-1 going-concern risk factor (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2095096/000149315226042440/formf-1.htm); H1 cash and burn (https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6423648). Asked what the money buys: the fleet ramp is corroborated (finding 5), but the going-concern flag keeps the sign negative.

findings.finding: Einride added non-dilutive, asset-backed funding during Q3 that matches the fleet ramp: a US equipment loan of up to $25m from Atel Growth Capital, secured on semi tractors (42-month tranches, rate factor 2.9867% a month; 6-K 2026-08-25), and an increase in its Norra Finans invoice-purchase limit from SEK 550m to SEK 650m, now including the US subsidiary (6-K 2026-10-01).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock moved -9.26% around the Oct 1 factoring 6-K (baseline bar data; cause not established).
findings.why_not_priced: The market read these as distress (Oct 1 -9%). They fund trucks and receivables for a ramp that is visible in the Tesla and Amazon deployments, so they ease equity needs at the margin. Expensive (about 25% total cost over 42 months on the Atel facility), but tied to revenue.
findings.independence: Factoring increase: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2095096/000149315226045378/form6-k.htm. The Tesla deployment ramp is corroborated by https://evwire.com/p/einride-75-tesla-semis-2026-rest-2027.

baseline_tension: There is no skew and no usable reaction history. The evidence leans slightly negative (financing, back-loaded quarter, sell-the-news on the first print). That agrees with the 20-day slide and cuts against the 5-day bounce, so p_up sits just under 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): I asked what the money buys. The facilities fund a corroborated fleet ramp, so they stay positive (+0.3). The EGM issuance authority sits beside a going-concern flag, so it stays negative, trimmed from -1.5 to -1.2 because the notice itself was public and the raise falls after the window.
Lesson 5 (inference smaller than documents): the Q3 back-loading finding is my own arithmetic, so it goes from -0.8 to -0.6.
Lesson 5 (a drawdown is not a cause): the low-bar expectations finding goes from +0.5 to +0.3, because the drawdown has a named negative cause (resale overhang).
Lesson 6 (unsourced bar): there is no consensus, so every finding is capped small. The H2 company guide is the stated bar.
Lesson 8 (thin name, larger moves) and the rule on untrustworthy histories: I rebuilt the base rate from the one confirmed release (-6.98%). abs_move_pct goes from 8 to 9 and p_up from 45 to 46.
